senses.definition: Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see put, aside.
To save or keep (something) to be used at a later time.
senses.example: I try to put a few dollars aside each week, just in case I need money in an emergency.

senses.definition: To ignore or intentionally disregard (something), temporarily or permanently, so that more important things can occupy one's attention.
senses.example: Let's put our differences aside for the moment, and get this project finished.
